major_concerns: External validity of synthetic topologies vs production networks
Verifier correctness and specification bugs could bias labels
LLM nondeterminism and prompt sensitivity may inflate model-call budget or confound paired comparisons
Sample-size/power for McNemar paired test not pre-specified
required_design_repairs: Provide provenance and public release plan for corpus; include diverse topology/policy strata
Independent validation and test-suite for verifier correctness (unit tests, canonical cases)
Pre-register sample size / power analysis and retry policy for API nondeterminism
Record and freeze full prompt templates, seeds/versions and include at least one model/version identifier in disclosure

major_concerns: High estimated model-call budget (cost and provider limits) may impede full five-iteration sweep
Operational threshold choice (e.g., 1%) is arbitrary without stakeholder justification
Repair-prompt template sensitivity could confound iteration-effect estimates
Potential conflation of verifier-feedback quality with true iteration effectiveness
required_design_repairs: Justify and/or vary operational thresholds; include sensitivity analysis across thresholds
Add a capped-budget arm (e.g., stop-after-N) to bound costs and report cost-per-success
Control and document repair-prompt templates; pre-register template set
Run provider rate-limit and cost feasibility check; include fallback plan if budget/rates exceeded

major_concerns: Provider APIs may not expose required log-probabilities or sufficient internals
Ensemble/paraphrase strategies increase call cost and latency
Performance on synthetic/public corpora may not generalize to proprietary configs
Risk of overfitting classifier to artifact signals without held-out tasks
required_design_repairs: Specify fallback signal set if logprobs unavailable (e.g., sequence-likelihood proxies, sampling-based agreement)
Pre-register ensemble size and paraphrase generation method and cap calls
Use strict held-out split and cross-validation; report bootstrap CIs and calibration metrics
Include operating-point analysis tied to realistic false-positive constraints for gating policies

major_concerns: Taxonomy labeling requires human annotation—subjectivity and resource needs
Simulated tool behavior may not capture production edge cases, biasing frequency estimates
Potential conflation of infrastructure/API errors with agent hallucinations
required_design_repairs: Publish a detailed codebook and annotation protocol and collect multiple annotators; report inter-rater agreement
Design simulator tool-response corpus to mirror real-world formats and document generation method
Add explicit instrumentation to separate infrastructure/API failures from agent hallucinations
Pre-register taxonomy categories and example mappings; include qualitative exemplar cases in artifacts
